decision: Add a dependency-free Node.js build gate that verifies exact root dependency lockfile agreement, licence metadata, a reviewed permissive SPDX allowlist, and npm registry provenance for all locked packages.
invariants: No new npm package is added by this change.
package-lock.json remains unchanged and authoritative for exact package versions and integrity metadata.
The checker uses only Node.js built-in modules.
Unknown, missing, or unapproved licence identifiers fail closed.
No production deployment, D1 mutation, secret, or paid service is introduced.
acceptance: All current locked packages pass the reviewed allowlist and provenance checks.
Direct dependencies in package.json match the lockfile root exactly.
Normal npm run build invokes the licence gate before other checks.
npm run check:licenses is available as a standalone command.
Cloudflare source validation, migration governance, Graphify and the normal build pass in CI.
releaseBoundary: Build-time dependency governance only; no runtime behavior or production data changes.
